G. 206-1-37

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ____
S.I, Special Branch. **〔此处转录不清〕**
REPORT
Date September 14, 1937.

Subject Assistance rendered to the Chinese Authorities in connection
with three persons who are wanted on a charge of illegal possession
of vehicle passes: S.S.D. Court Warrants Nos. 2573, 2574 & 2575.
Made by D.S.I. Laurier Forwarded by C. Crawford O.

Vice-Captain Shu Bang Fei (許飛) of the Detective
Corps attached to the Martial Law Commander's Office, came
to this branch on 9th September, and requested assistance
in arresting the following three persons on a charge of
"falsely representing themselves to be the possessors of
vehicle passes in contravention of the order governing
Martial Laws"

Soo Kya Mai (蘇家楣) of 423 South Soochow Road.
Loh Nan Tsau (陸南煦) of room 330, National Commercial
Bank building, 230 Peking Road.
Tseu Zu Chuan (周士) of 73, Ningpo Road.

The warrants of arrest in respect of these persons were
issued by Judge Dzien of the Shanghai Special District Court
at the request of the Woosung & Shanghai Garrison Commander's
Headquarters and are numbered 2573, 2574 and 2575 respectively.

D.S.I. Laurier and C.D.S. 155 of this branch, accompanied
by D.S. Hyde of Central Station, rendered the necessary
assistance but failed to locate any of the wanted men at the
addresses given.

On September 2, 1937, the Chinese Police of the 2nd
Division arrested in the vicinity of the Small West Gate,
Nantao, three men in possession of three trucks bearing vehicle
passes issued by the Martial Law Commander's Office. It was
found on investigation that these men had no legal right to the
passes and on being interrogated they implicated the three men
mentioned in the warrants as being the persons to whom the
passes had originally been issued. The absence of any proof
to show that the men mentioned in the warrants have a lawful
right to the vehicle passes forms the basis of the charge.

（左侧批注：File / D.R. / 15/9）
（印章：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER / 15 SEP 1937 / (C)）
（底部批注：D.O.A / **〔此处手写签名及数字难以辨认，似为 Nannini ... S.B. 15/9 ...〕** / P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)）

G. 206-1-37

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号 ____
S.I，特务科。**〔此处转录不清〕**
报告
日期：1937年9月14日。

事由：就三名因涉嫌非法持有车辆通行证而被通缉的人员，向中方当局提供协助事宜：上海特区地方法院逮捕令编号 2573、2574 及 2575。
由警司 Laurier 撰写，由 C. Crawford O. 转呈。

隶属于戒严司令官办公室侦缉队的许飞（Shu Bang Fei）副队长于9月9日来到本科，请求协助逮捕以下三人，指控其“违反戒严令，虚假声称自己为车辆通行证持有人”：

苏州路423号的苏家楣（Soo Kya Mai）。
北京路230号中国商业大楼330室的陆南煦（Loh Nan Tsau）。
宁波路73号的周士（Tseu Zu Chuan）。

针对上述人员的逮捕令系应吴淞上海警备司令部之请，由上海特区地方法院 Dzien 法官签发，编号分别为 2573、2574 和 2575。

本科警司 Laurier 和第155号华探， accompanied by 中央捕房警佐 Hyde，提供了必要协助，但在所给地址未能找到任何一名被通缉者。

1937年9月2日，南市第二区华捕在小西门附近逮捕了三名男子，他们拥有三辆卡车，车上载有由戒严司令官办公室签发的车辆通行证。经调查，发现这些人对通行证并无合法权利，且在受审时供称，逮捕令中提到的三人是最初获得这些通行证的人。由于缺乏证据证明逮捕令中提及的人对车辆通行证拥有合法权利，这构成了指控的基础。

（左侧批注：档案 / D.R. / 9月15日）
（印章：副总监 / 1937年9月15日 / (C)）
（底部批注：D.O.A / **〔此处手写签名及数字难以辨认，似为 Nannini ... S.B. 15/9 ...〕** / 助理副总监（特务科））

against them. In vie. of the failure of the police to locate
the wanted men on September 9th, the Chinese Authorities'
representative requested that the warrants, which are valid
until 15th September, be held temporarily pending a further
attempt to ascertain the whereabouts of the wanted men.
On September 13th Vice-Captain Chu Bang Fei informed
this office that he had been unable to obtain the desired
information: these warrants are therefore returned for
cancellation.
